**Teriyaki Eggplant & Mushroom Don** on Cookpad, by 2 Cancerians cook, Libra eats, includes both eggplant and mushrooms: https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/17110323

- **Ingredients (3 servings):** 2–3 eggplants, 8–9 shiitake mushrooms, sweet onion, oil, sake, mirin, shoyu or tamari, garlic, gochujang, dark soy sauce, maple syrup, green onions and sesame seeds.
- **Method (45 minutes):** Soak the cut eggplant in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain and squeeze it. Sauté it with the mushrooms and onion until browned. Add the mixed teriyaki sauce and reduce it. Serve over rice with green onion and sesame seeds.
- **Spice level:** The author says this is a spicier version of the original recipe.

It ranked 1st for "eggplant" and 3rd for "mushroom" in Cookpad search.

Other results from the same search that look relevant are "California Farm Eggplant Schnitzel in Mushroom Sauce" and "Aubergine and Mushroom Balls". I didn't open those two.
